Preserve these distinctions: selected fragments versus exhaustive pure environment;
actual visibility versus a compatible fidelity envelope or history probability-sum defect;
conditional errors versus average error; fixed-positive-budget asymptotics versus
varying-budget limits; pairwise versus joint independence; written proof versus
finite numerical checks; reconstructed mathematics versus verified priority.
Additional purifiers are explicitly outside the constrained record partition.
A perfectly correlated two-point family has a different correlation cost from the
independently noisy common-flip construction. Bavaro Corollary 6.3 already uses
the same relative-entropy total correlation. Credit that bound and the standard
visibility envelope; distinguish direct specialization, our blockwise deduction,
state-specific Bures-angle information and our sharp fixed-budget extremal law.
Both identified full-text comparisons are resolved for the inspected versions;
this does not establish exhaustive priority. No educational anchor has been
selected. No personal coaching procedure belongs in this repository.
